headline: Atrisa advertises founding analog-design work to build circuit tools and AI-agent evaluations
fact: Atrisa posted a Founding Analog Design Engineer role in Bengaluru on its Y Combinator recruiting page. The company describes building AI agents for analog circuit design. The role designs, simulates and verifies analog/mixed-signal blocks and works with software and AI engineers to turn circuit-design problems into tools and evaluations. It includes specification tradeoffs, schematic design, SPICE simulation, layout review and silicon validation. This is an advertised circuit-design and evaluation mandate, not evidence that agents autonomously complete specification-to-layout designs or have achieved silicon results.
